findings.message: The Scope in text for `phase5-exit` has it select the latest committed `tickets/retro/[0-9]{6}.md` and require that the report follow the latest Phase 5 feature merge. It never names the emitter. Section 20 says this report must have been committed by the drain's forced pre-phase-exit retro hook (merged `retro-drain-invoker`, which writes `tickets/retro/<seq>.md` under effect key `retro/<seq>`). The merged `retro-doctor-cli` manual `retro` verb can also commit a report there, so without a named producer the exit accepts a report of the wrong provenance. The acceptance criteria and `tests/test_seeded_phase5_04.py` therefore cannot pin this exit read's closure.
findings.paved_road: State in Scope in, and pin in the acceptance criterion for `tests/test_seeded_phase5_04.py`, that the authored `phase5-exit` names merged `retro-drain-invoker` (`squatch/retro.py`, the `retro/<seq>` commit effect) as the machinery. It must also name the drain's forced pre-phase-exit retro hook as the producer that committed the selected latest `tickets/retro/<seq>.md` after the latest Phase 5 feature merge. Use section 20's Phase 5 exit evidence wording.
